violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Various cheese and deli meats were observed held at 46-50 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC voluntarily disposed of at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
Refrigerator #2 was not in good repair, ambient observed at 46F. PIC took unit out of service at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
